metadata.description: BotChatter's open-source plugin for supported ChatGPT / Dots, Grok Bot, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor hosts: read your own Telegram and WhatsApp chats through the BotChatter MCP server, with human approval for every reply.

plugins.name: botchatter
plugins.description: Read your own Telegram and personal WhatsApp (beta) chats from your assistant: catch up, search, find chats and people, and draft replies sent only after you confirm them in the chat. Includes agent sign-up for autonomous agents.
